correctness.rationale: The exact nM edge-state identity is derived from conditional uniform seed choice. All labeled graphs through n=5, every permutation, and every open-edge subset are enumerated with exact integers. Both degree-ambiguous order-five pairs have fixed-sign factors. Independent pairwise unicyclic reliability and open-edge-state methods yield the same six-vertex polynomials; a monotone quadratic yields one interior crossing. See RESULT.md and verify.py/certificate.json.

Claims of broader SIR equivalence are explicitly excluded.

value.rationale: The sharp smallest connected example isolates a consequential ambiguity in using degree summaries to compare epidemic risk across transmissibility, even at equal triangle counts. The natural risk functional has a nontrivial exact unique switching threshold, and five-vertex impossibility is established by complete classification. This is a motivated finite structural boundary, not a mere calculation or arbitrary parameter slice.
